newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela channel stays open to shipping - agent.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela channel stays open to shipping - agent.

text.p: Venezuela's Lake Maracaibo shipping channel stayed open to tanker traffic Thursday morning despite a protest by fishermen, shipping agents in Maracaibo said.

Fishermen's union Fetrapesca had vowed to paralyse the channel for three hours from 0900 local/1300 GMT to bring attention to their $292.5 million claim against the owners of the Nissos Amorgos tanker which spilled 25,000 barrels of crude oil in the channel on Feb 28.
"The Coast Guard is clearing the channel and ships are coming in and out," a shipping agent in Maracaibo said.
Another shipping source said the Maracaibo port captain had ordered protestors to stay in the shallow waters near San Carlos island, the site of the oilspill.
"He said he would use Coast Guard vessels to prevent them blocking the channel. The protest is going ahead but will not be allowed to restrict shipping," he added.
